body:
Running the MRP on Windows 10 i got this result: ``` Symbol: add_child Time in usec text: 5795 ☠: 2626 ½: 200 ☥: 2102 Δ: 447 ⚥: 637 ®: 139 𝜎: 934 x²: 338 ```
Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8509) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

I stumbled upon this issue too today, when working on my small non-game Godot project.
I investigated why my application started a bit slowly and found the issue to be the many labels containing the dotted circle ◌ character at the time of instantiation.
Leaving the text in inspector empty and adding a script to the labels which sets the string in the `_ready()` function solved this issue as a workaround.
```gdscript
extends Label

func _ready() -> void:
	text = "◌";
```
### System Information
Godot v4.6.3.stable
Linux Mint 22.3 with i3 on X11
AMD Ryzen 7700X
AMD Radeon RX 7800XT
64 GB DDR 5

The root cause of the issue is that the required text glyph is not found in the provided font and system fallback fonts are searched. However, there are many system fonts to search for and that takes quite a lot of time. There is system font cache to help, which is used if the same glyph is requested again, but it only helps a little bit. To improve performance, system font searching should be reduced to a minimum. A dedicated font can be used. In font settings (during import or in resource), "Allow System Fallback" can be disabled, so it would be clear which glyphs are using expensive system fallback. Then, in "Fallbacks" section, any fonts can be added which fixes missing glyphs. In my case, system "Adwaita Mono" font has "𝜎" which is not included in my imported DejaVu Sans font. I've tested the performance, and it improved considerably. Furthermore, font glyphs can be prerendered in font import settings, to improve performance even more. "𝜎" symbol has higher time due to being the only glyph in the example which is not part of DejaVu Sans font. However, even then, using specific font fallback improves its performance by 4x. Here's performance improved MRP. I have tested it on Arch Linux. Note that on different platforms (e.g. Windows), different system fallback fonts should be used or multiple platform system fonts should be added to the fallback list. [MRP-bug-116216.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30389362/MRP-bug-116216.zip)
